scope: 20 pre-sealed shopmall functions, 77 immutable B evidence records, three A repeats
observed_failure_classes: C negation remained as ! and failed Python parsing
pointer dereference, address-of and C casts remained in relations
long source calls were truncated into invalid expressions
exact rows sometimes emitted an empty then_relation
same mutable variable at different condition coordinates was collapsed into a false contradiction
JSON-schema transport still produced four JSON decode failures
false_unreachable_coordinates: shipping_request:R967 (rc is reassigned between the two tests)
member_authenticate:R730 (rc changes from decrypt result to SMS result)
conclusion: A remains KEEP/experimental. It is not safe as the baseline: schema row coverage was strong after successful JSON, but Python syntax, repeat identity and temporal def-use semantics were not guaranteed. Invalid or temporally ambiguous relations must fail closed rather than enter the graph.
non_generalization: These figures cover only the sealed 20 functions and do not establish meaning accuracy for all 1609 RULE rows.
